Ambiguous requirement: Instruction says 'content paragraph' but doesn't define which paragraph. Getter assumes a specific text content without positional/structural identification.
Edge case failure: If no shape contains 'Neural networks are', getter returns None and task fails even if correct paragraph was resized.
Inconsistent implementation: Code comment says 'second shape, index 1' but actual code iterates all shapes searching by text, creating confusion about intended logic.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace hardcoded text search with structural identification (e.g., check shape at specific index, or identify by placeholder type/name)

Use shape.placeholder_format or shape position/index instead of text content matching
